title: First steps
summary: Your first hour in SkyRPG: your Private Island, the SkyBlock Menu, the Hub's areas, your first collections and minion, and your first coins.

s.x: , a small floating island of grass with an oak tree and a portal to the Hub. This page is a route through your first hour: what to open, where to walk, what to collect and where the first coins come from. It follows the same loop as Hypixel SkyBlock: gather, unlock, craft, sell, repeat.

Press K and look at the SkyBlock Menu once.
Walk through the portal and meet the village's merchants. Find the Banker and the Bartender.
Cross to the Farm, the Forest and the Coal Mine and gather until each skill is at level 1 or 2.
Kill a few zombies in the Graveyard for Combat XP.
Sell what you gathered, and check the Collections page for new tiers.
Craft your first minion from the Recipe Book and place it on your island.
Go back to the Hub and hunt Fairy Souls on your way to Tia.
Open the Settings page once and glance at the HUD and Map options. See
Some fights are tougher than they look. The Ruins' wolves attack on sight, and the Hub Crypts' Golden Ghoul has 45,000 health. Stay on the Graveyard and the Farm until your Combat level is up.
